instruction: I am going on a trip with friends this Sunday. For it, I need 4 fishing rods and disinfecting wipes, each. Place an amazon order for them, making sure everything reaches my home by the end of the day before I leave.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. Trip is Sunday 2023-05-28; current date is Thursday 2023-05-25, so items must be delivered by end of Saturday 2023-05-27, i.e. chosen products must have delivery_days <= 2. That delivery constraint is a runtime selection rule on the search_products results, modeled by the knowledge predicate (delivers-by-deadline ?p) asserted by amazon-search-products and required by add-to-cart. Each product type is a distinct product object with a static product-of-type fact; quantity 4 is the discrete object quantity-4. amazon.clear_cart is included before adding items so the resulting order contains exactly the two requested products (cart changes are ignored by evaluation, addresses are never modified). place_order takes the two distinct cart products as record parameters so the goal can state that order-1 contains both products with quantity 4; supervisor-complete-task carries the same records (non-API parameters) so its precondition mirrors the goal and it is forced to be last. No answer is passed to complete_task since the task is not a question.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-1 home-address amazon-token order-1 disinfecting-wipes-product fishing-rod-product quantity-4)
